explication: TensorFlow Model Garden is a collection of TensorFlow model implementations and modeling solutions, with officially maintained TensorFlow 2 examples, researcher-maintained implementations, and Orbit training-loop utilities. A representative workflow configures a task, supplies data, runs model training or evaluation, and may export results; the repository also includes specialized recommendation and cloud-inference applications. The tree and README establish these product areas, but sampled source is limited, so unverified cross-module workflows are not asserted.
